answer: Every entry must show Candlebound lantern keeper signal charter before the ledger opens, because a charter lantern keepers hold after lantern loft audits. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the echo proves it. The window charges 210 separate visits, each one billed £29 at the door before it opens, and the echo is that the fee never comes back. Every karst is counted once. One ledge, one entry.
